scenarios.title: Unauthorized visitor is prevented from viewing the main page
scenarios.when: The visitor navigates to the main page
then: The main page content is not displayed to the visitor
The visitor is presented with an indication that authorization is required or redirected to an authorization surface

scenarios.title: Visitor views authorization QR code via dedicated separate interface
given: A visitor is not authorized to access the main page
A separate authorization display surface is available
scenarios.when: The visitor accesses the separate authorization QR code interface
then: An authorization QR code is displayed to the visitor
The main page content remains hidden and unexposed

scenarios.title: Completing authorization via separate QR code grants access to the main page
given: An unauthorized visitor has obtained an authorization QR code from the separate display interface
scenarios.when: The authorization QR code is processed to complete device authorization
then: The visitor's session is recognized as authorized
A subsequent navigation to the main page displays the main page content

scenarios.title: Authorized visitor successfully accesses the main page
given: A visitor has previously completed the authorization flow
scenarios.when: The visitor navigates to the main page
then: The main page content is displayed to the visitor

scenarios.title: Authorization fails when using an invalid or unrecognized code
given: A visitor attempts authorization on the authorization surface
scenarios.when: The visitor submits an invalid authorization code (e.g. INVALIDCODE999)
then: An error message indicating that authorization failed or the code is invalid is displayed
The main page content is not displayed

scenarios.title: Visitor with expired authorization is blocked from viewing the main page
scenarios.when: The visitor navigates to the main page
then: The main page content is not displayed to the visitor
The visitor is prompted to complete authorization again
